APOC appears in the MSR1highC1QBhigh macrophage definition but is not a unique gene symbol (APOC1/2/3/4 candidate ambiguity) and is not represented in the candidate list; it was therefore not reported as a new finding.
ATubulin in Figure S2I is a flow cytometry antigen label rather than a unique gene symbol; candidate 59 was excluded as a non-gene entity.
